paragraphs: R' Shmuel bar Yannai: I did not find him. Possibly Yuhasin means that in Jerusalem Ta'anit, beginning and end of chapter 2, R' Shmuel bar Yannai reports in R' Aha's name. But the matter mentioned at the end of chapter 2 is the one mentioned in Jerusalem Ha-Holetz, halakhah 11, as bar Inaya, who is the person mentioned immediately above. In Jerusalem Ellu Devarim: R' Shmuel bar Mina in R' Aha's name—all one person. In Helek, halakhah 2: bar Bina in R' Aha's name. It appears to be all one person. Yuhasin also brings Rav Shmuel bar Ahini. In Midrash Kohelet, at “All the streams”: bar Hovah in R' Aha's name; at the end of Tzav, bar Ivi; in Yefeh To'ar, bar Inni; in Bereshit Rabbah, chapter 5, bar Hana. It is all one matter.
